findings.quote: Who This Is Not For: "For self-directed trading, Empower and Wealthfront provide stock and ETF trading."
findings.problem: Required 'Who This Is Not For' section is a one-sentence stub that does not say who the page or Empower is not for (not-for gate).
findings.fix: Rewrite as a short list: readers wanting a human advisor under $100,000, readers wanting one-fee budgeting-only software, readers who need Empower's advisory percentage before deciding (it is only in Form ADV), readers needing a tax or legal opinion.

findings.quote: Sentence rhythm across the body (121 sentences: 6 short, 29 medium, 86 long)
findings.problem: monotone-rhythm: a run of 13 consecutive long (15+ word) sentences, measured from body prose (intro, choose section, alternatives, verdict, FAQ answers).
findings.fix: Vary real sentences in the 'How to Choose' and Fidelity Go/Betterment sections; shorten some fact statements, no padding.

findings.quote: Monarch Money section body opens "It offers two subscription tiers..."
findings.problem: Section opens with a pronoun and no named subject right under the heading; vague first sentence.
findings.fix: Open with "Monarch Money is a personal finance app...".

findings.quote: Verdict: "...select the service that matches your operational needs."
findings.problem: Mild directive; the page lists products and should end on a concrete next action without telling the reader what to select.
findings.fix: Change to a next-action sentence such as comparing your balance with each minimum listed in the table above.
